summary.text: Kevin Mannix is a Republican state representative from District 21 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Mannix graduated from Wakefield High School in 1967, earned a B.A. in liberal arts from the University of Virginia in 1971 and a J.D. from the University of Virginia Law School in 1974.
His career includes work as an Oregon Court of Appeals law clerk, assistant attorney general in Oregon and in the U.S. Territory of Guam, administrative law judge in Oregon, and in private practice.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Mannix said he has owned a law firm in Salem since 1986.
Mannix was vice-chair of the Republican Party of Oregon from 1999 to 2001 and was elected chair of the party in 2003, serving through 2005.
In the 2024 survey he said he previously served as an Oregon state representative for ten years, leaving the legislature in 2001, and returned in 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Higher Education and Workforce Development Committee and several joint committees, including as co-chair of the Joint Conduct Committee.
